notes.title: Date of Warlocks vs Shadows full release on STEAM.
notes.content:
Hello guys,

The time has finally come, we are leaving Early Access :)

We will be releasing full version of Warlocks vs Shadows on August 19th.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Y1yinrZ.jpg[/IMG]

Prepare yourself for upcoming changes:

- adding 9 new languages! (Polish, German, Italian, French, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese)

- adding new online mode - Versus.

- adding brand new character - Zardonic, the Bass Wizard.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ot1YTyj.jpg[/IMG]
 

Zardonic’s real name is Federico Augusto Ágreda Álvarez. Born in Venezuela he started his music career back in 2004. Today this multi-instrumentalist, DJ, composer and mixer, whose fingerprints dirtied remixes from Australian speedcore merchants The Berzerker, long-running Norwegian black metal titans Gorgoroth and massive standard bearers Nine Inch Nails, is dubbed as Venezuela's top DJ act and one of the Top 10 best DJ masks in the world. He’s releases instantly become Amazon’s Hard Rock & Metal Bestseller.

Zardonic has recorded and prepared all the voice-overs and sound effects for his in-game character!

PS. In the next few days we will be making survey for all backers who are going to obtain physical goodies.

notes.title: New gameplay mode - Horde Mode live now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Many of you guys were asking us on our Steam Community Group about making a new gameplay mode. So we are listening to you, and we've started to work on it. And now it's ready, so we can proudly announce that with today's update you will be able to test it by yourself :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0wNlosY.png[/img]

Take a look at the brand new Endless Horde Mode features:

•	5 new arenas with endless waves of shadow monsters.
•	Leaderboards for local and on-line scores. 
•	On-line and off-line co-operation mode up to 4 players.

Despite the new gameplay mode we yet again delivered a whole bunch of fixes and improvements so if you’re curious to learn them all dive into the list below:

• The look of Spirit Lord's ghosts after the 4th upgrade of his Ethernall Leap skill was changed.
• The Xbox One controller plug in has been updated. Controllers should work properly now.
• The portal on the last stage (boss room) of the Shadow World was fixed.
• A bug with online multiplayer which caused players to desync (connected with Jake's C) was fixed.
• A bug with multiple slows stacking causing you to run backwards was fixed.
• Reviving one more time was fixed.
• The potions bug was fixed.
• Levels displayed in character selection screen were added.
• Statistics screen after every level you beat in the Story Mode (both in single and multiplayer) was added.
• The difficulty in the 4th world - Frozen Lake (stronger enemies and more of them) was increased.
• The thin ranged monster from Frozen Lake has silence on his projectiles now.
• Giant Ice Scarab from Frozen Lake has slow on his attack now.
• The difficulty in the 5th world - Shadow World (stronger enemies) has been increased.
• The silence to Assassin from Shadow World and slow to the ranged monster were added.
• The 3rd boss (more HP and new shooting pattern) was buffed.
• 4th and 5th bosses' HP was significantly increased.
• Nerfed Jamal, Troll Warlord. His range of Axe Throw after the upgrade got significantly reduced and his cool-down on Avalanche got increased. Also his Bleeding effect on Axe Throw got nerfed along with Axe Throw's cool-down.
• The ability to bounce from enemies on Jamal's upgraded Dodge was removed.
• Nerfed Jake's fireball's range, reduced its cool-down after the upgrade from 1s to 0.8s.
• Nerfed Lissy - increased the cool-down on Charge and on Overdrive, also reduced Overdrive's duration (but increased the healing from it).
• Buffed Raziel - increased his damage and damage bonus scaling on Sword Smash.
• Iezabel’s minions HP, armor and damage were increased significantly.
• Nerfed "of Ice" suffix from 80% slow to 65% on weapons and 70% on armors.
• The volume of Shadow World's music was increased.
• Some platforms on stage 2-5 were fixed.

So as you can see there are a lot of changes!

We can't wait to see your high scores in the Horde Mode leaderboards, let the best win!

notes.title: Warlocks vs Shadows expands with the new Shadow World and the Blood Mage Iezabel!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are still working hard on our game! Now you have the chance to check the power of the new character – Iezebel, the Blood Mage. You can also visit the brand new Shadow World.

Here is a list of Iezebel's skills:

Z - Iezabel shoots 2 projectiles that apply the Blood Mark to every enemy they hit. The Blood Mark enhances the damage dealt by your minions.
 

X - Iezabel bursts out blood that damages nearest enemies, this spell also forces her minions to do the same.
 

C - Spawns a cloud of blood - slowing and damaging any trespassing enemies, at the same time teleporting Iezabel forward.
 

V - It's your bread and butter ability; it spawns a minion that'll serve you and fight for you until it dies.

Jump into the game and check all that has changed. It may take you a while, as the list of changes this time is really impressive! :)

• Added new character: Iezabel, the Blood Mage
• Added new world: Shadow World 
• Added level selection after beating a game 
• Added voice-over sounds for all characters and a lot of other sound effects
• Added Steam Cloud Save system 
• Saves are now encrypted (your progress will be wiped) and each character has his own save file 
• Added announcer picking sounds
• Nerfed Lissy (her skills still add heat even on high levels) 
• Nerfed Kheera's heal 
• Nerfed Vampiric Aura from 10-20% to 5-10% 
• Small spiders that spawn in world 2 don't give EXP anymore 
• Fixed a bug where you could move with the Merchant's menu open 
• Fixed a bug where you could wipe out your progress by trying to change your character •	Fixed a bug where monsters were getting stuck on the platform corners 
• Fixed a bug with disappearing lobby rooms 
• Fixed a few bugs with profile names 
• Fixed the area in which you can revive your teammates 
• Fixed a bug with music on the Frozen Lake boss 
• Fixed a bug with the game not counting your play time properly 
• Fixed a bug with Rainer's heals stacking 
• Fixed a few bugs where you could jump outside the level 
• Fixed a few bugs with entering/exiting lobby rooms 
• Fixed a bug with co-op forcing you to level-up a skill even though you couldn't 
• Fixed a bug with rebinding keys 
• Fixed a bug where leaving and re-entering lobby would cause glitches 
• Fixed a few visibility issues in third boss map 
• You can now exit the Merchant's menu by pressing Esc 

And... 

We still have some aces hidden up our sleeves. A brand new gameplay mode anyone? But this will be announced when the right time comes. 

To learn more about the game visit the official website: http://www.omlgames.com, Facebook https://www.facebook.com/omlgames and Twitter https://twitter.com/oml_games profiles.

notes.title: Attention please! Upcoming update will wipe your saves.
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We were working on changing a save system in our game. Unfortunately your old saves won't work, because we are adding Steam Cloud Save system and a separate saves for each character. So now you will be able to have different progress on different character.

We are bringing other big changes to that update to:
- Added new character: Iezabel, the Blood Mage
- Added new world: Shadow World
- Added voice-over sounds for all characters and a lot of other sound effects
- Added Steam Cloud Save
- POSSIBILITY TO SELECT WHICH STAGE YOU WANT TO REPLAY AFTER BEATING A GAME (level selection)
- Saves are now encrypted (your progress will be wiped) and each character has his own save file

Full patch notes coming soon.

We hope that these big changes will reward you this inconvenience.

Update will go live later this week.

notes.title: Time for a Frozen Lake update!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Now it's a time for a bigger update! :)

Today we are adding a new world - Frozen Lake, so you will be able to continue your journey and level up your character!

Next thing is unlocking a new character - Jamal - Troll Warlord, who is a mighty warlock with a power of freezing ice and countless throwing axes.

Here is a description of his skills:

[Z] Axe Throw - Jamal throwing his axes, which adds bleeding effect to a target. When upgraded to tier 2 axe is penetrating its target.
[X] Axe Rain - Jamal throwing over a dozne axes to the air, which are falling to the ground around him. When upgraded to tier 2 the number of axes is increased.
[C] Dodge - Jamal is jumping back, dealing damage to enemies nearby. During the flight he is invulnerable. When upgraded to tier 2 he is bouncing back from the last enemy he hit and adding a slow effect.
[V] Avalanche - powerful magic attack, stunning a target and dealing damage. When upgraded to tier 2 Jamal is shooting an avalanche to the both of his sides.

Another feature which could be interesting for you is a fact that previously unlocked characters will be unlocked also on other in-game profiles, so you will be able to start a journey from the very beginning with character from further worlds!

Full patch notes (Frozen Lake update):

- Added a new world: Frozen Lake!
- Added a new character: Jamal, Troll Warlord!
- Unlocked characters are now global and work on all profiles.
- Changed Swampland's music to a final version.
- Extended revive zone even further.
- Extended timeout time to 10s in co-op online
- Moved portal after 2 boss a little higher.
- Fixed a bug where you could pause the game while changing levels and therefore corrupting your save.
- Fixed a bug where a tresure chest sfx would ignore your sfx volume.
- Fixed a bug where you could jump out of the map in Swamplands.
- Fixed a bug where spawn portal on 3rd boss would be behind the boss for players 2-4.
- Fixed a bug where you could enter portal on connection timeout (and therefore crashing your game) 

If you would like to recieve more information like One More Level and Warlocks vs Shadows fanpage on facebook: https://www.facebook.com/omlgames

notes.title: Patch note and title change.
notes.content:
Hi guys!

After almost a week since the game’s release on Steam Early Access during which the game was selling better than big AAA titles out there, the first update for Warlocks is here and other than adding several improvements to the gameplay it also changes its name. Warlocks is now Warlocks vs Shadows!

Warlocks sure did get some attention from gamers all over the world. That’s quite a success for us! Gamers enjoy the game massively rewarding it with almost only positive reviews on Steam. On the other hand there were quite some complains about… the game’s title. So with the first update we decided not only to add several improvements but also change the name from Warlocks into Warlocks vs Shadows.

The decision was made to meet gamers expectations. Players pointed out that the name is a bit too general and with many other things out there having something to do with some kind of ‘Warlocks’ (there’s a rock band of that name even!) it was sometimes a bit hard to immediately find information about the game. So to avoid further confusion and to show that gamers’ opinion is important to the team, we decided to turn Warlocks into Warlocks vs Shadows.

We believe that the new name reflects better what the game really is.. You play as one of warlocks, you slay hordes of shadow enemies and you can do it not only in single player but also in a co-op and versus mode. Also there won’t be any better time for this change as the game keeps getting gamers and media attention. So we wanted to use this opportunity and give the game a new name while it’s still in Early Access.

New patch notes:

- Added new music for Swamplands
- Added knockback to Borubar's club strike
- Added unready option in online lobby
- Nerfed Pyromancer
- Buffed third boss
- Increased difficulty with more players in party (monsters hp +50%/player -> +70%/player)
- Fixed occurances where you couldn't revive a player
- Fixed Shamaness's curse sound effect ignoring sfx volume
- Fixed second boss rendering in front of player
- Steam Achievements integration
